pair.ask: How does skill system work? When a skill block is in my latest message, what do I do?
pair.explain: I treat every <skill> block as a fresh, independent invocation. I identify the mode by reading the bare argument in the text immediately following the current block's closing tag. I reply with the exact short confirmation line required for that specific mode.
